title: Task repository over the tasks table
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-01-task-basics.md → 'Domain (src/lib/tasks/)' and 'Definitions of done → Epic 1'. Read it first. The persistence layer (src/lib/db: openDatabase, createTestDb, migration 0001 with the tasks table) and src/lib/tasks/types.ts (Task, TaskInput) already exist on this branch: read them before writing.

Deliver src/lib/tasks/repository.ts with these exports, every function taking the DatabaseSync handle first:
- listTasks(db): { open: Task[]; done: Task[] } — open = done_at IS NULL ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC; done = done_at IS NOT NULL ordered by done_at DESC, id DESC.
- getTask(db, id: number): Task | null
- createTask(db, input: TaskInput): Task — inserts with created_at = updated_at = new Date().toISOString(), done_at NULL, returns the stored row.
- updateTask(db, id, input: TaskInput): Task | null — sets title, notes, updated_at; null when the id does not exist.
- setDone(db, id, done: boolean): Task | null — done=true sets done_at to now if currently NULL (no-op if already done); done=false sets done_at NULL if currently set (no-op if already open); both bump updated_at only when they change something; null for an unknown id.
- deleteTask(db, id): boolean — true when a row was deleted.
Map rows to Task with camelCase fields (doneAt, createdAt, updatedAt). Do not validate input here (validate.ts is a sibling tick); the CHECK constraints are the last line of defence.

Test cases (test-first) in src/lib/tasks/repository.integration.test.ts, each test on its own createTestDb() closed in afterEach:
- listTasks on an empty db → { open: [], done: [] }
- createTask({title: "Buy milk", notes: ""}) returns id 1, doneAt null, createdAt === updatedAt (ISO string), and listTasks().open[0].title === "Buy milk"
- three creates → open is newest first (ids 3, 2, 1)
- setDone(id, true) → returned task has doneAt set; listTasks().open lacks it and done has it; two done tasks are ordered by doneAt DESC (use distinct timestamps: mark the first one done, then the second; second must come first; if timestamps tie, id DESC decides — assert the order [2, 1])
- setDone(id, true) twice → second call returns the same doneAt (no-op)
- setDone(id, false) → back in open with doneAt null
- updateTask(id, {title: "Buy oat milk", notes: "2 litres"}) → fields changed and updatedAt >= createdAt; getTask returns the same
- getTask(999) → null; updateTask(999, …) → null; setDone(999, true) → null
- deleteTask(id) → true, then false; getTask → null
- createTask with a 201-character title throws (CHECK constraint)

Files likely touched: src/lib/tasks/repository.ts (new), src/lib/tasks/repository.integration.test.ts (new). Nothing else; do not touch docs (the epic's docs page for this layer, how/tasks.md, is written in the next epic) and do not touch validate.ts.
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
